chunks: Then he said to them on oath: "I am your sincere friend;"

key_terms.قَاسَمَهُمَا: He swore an oath to the two of them

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'wa qasamahuma inni lakuma lina min an-nasihin' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse records Iblis's oath to Adam and Hawwa, emphasizing his deceptive claim of sincere guidance despite his true intent to mislead. Shia exegesis highlights this as a pivotal moment where the adversary uses divine-sounding authority to initiate the fall, illustrating the subtlety of spiritual deception. The phrase underscores the rhetorical power of oaths in establishing credibility, even when the speaker's motives are ultimately contrary to divine will.
